title: ChemE-as-Code: An Open-Source Platform for Agentic AI in Chemical Engineering
title_zh: ChemE-as-Code：面向化工领域智能体 AI 的开源平台

paragraphs.en: ChemE-as-Code provides an open-source environment in which AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) can carry out chemical engineering work and engineers can check it. Its calculation tools range from catalysis through process simulation to plant layout, HAZOP and life cycle assessment, and skills tell a general-purpose agent how to use them. Engineering files are linked, machine-readable and versioned in Git; calculations run outside the LLM, each value records its origin, and automated checks report inconsistencies and out-of-date results by file and line. In an illustrative ammonia case, agents developed a written task into a preliminary basic-engineering package (simulation files, P&IDs, layout, HAZOP, datasheets, relief) for USD 224 of API cost in the design sessions. Planted faults and engineering changes show that the checks find what their rules cover and miss the rest, so they guide human review rather than replace it. No independent engineer has reviewed the design.

paragraphs.en: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to reshape chemical engineering [ 1 , 2 ] . AI agents, its newest form, can go beyond answering questions: they can use tools, edit files and iterate on their own results [ 3 , 4 ] . Engineering work can thus increasingly be proposed, executed and revised by computational agents. In the past years, software development has shown what this opens up. AI assistants have sped up well-defined programming tasks [ 5 ] , and the length of tasks that agents complete on their own keeps growing [ 6 ] . Software teams can use agents in this way because their work already lives in versioned text files that automated tests can check. We expect chemical process engineering to benefit in the same way once its work takes the same form.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）有望重塑化学工程 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 AI 智能体是其最新形态，不仅能回答问题，还能使用工具、编辑文件并自行迭代其结果 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 因此，工程工作将越来越多地可以由计算智能体提出、执行和修改。 过去几年，软件开发已经展示了这能带来什么。 AI 助手已加快了定义明确的编程任务 [ 5 ] ，而智能体能独立完成的任务的长度也在持续增长 [ 6 ] 。 软件团队之所以能这样使用智能体，是因为他们的工作本就存在于版本化的文本文件中，且可由自动化测试加以检查。 我们预计，一旦化学过程工程的工作也采取同样的形式，它将以同样的方式从中受益。

paragraphs.en: That form is harder to reach in chemical engineering than in software. A plant is described by many coupled documents: process models, specifications, process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), equipment data, layouts, safety studies and environmental inventories. P&IDs are the central reference documents of a plant over its life cycle [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] and are still created largely by hand [ 7 , 10 ] . The documents depend on each other, but the dependencies are rarely recorded. This means that a change in one place, such as a higher design capacity, silently invalidates numbers elsewhere: in the simulation, the drawings, the equipment data, the layout, the safety analysis and the inventory [ 11 ] . Nothing tells the engineer which of them. Much process information also still sits in documents that must be digitized before a change can be assessed [ 12 ] . Integrated information models, exchange standards and digital threads address parts of this problem [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . They let tools exchange data. They do not record, for a whole project and at every revision, which results are still consistent with each other, which are out of date, and who has reviewed what.
paragraphs.zh: 这种形式在化学工程中比在软件中更难达到。 一个工厂由许多相互关联的文档来描述：工艺模型、规范、工艺流程图（PFD）、管道与仪表图（P&ID）、设备数据、布置图、安全研究和环境清单。 P&ID 是工厂在整个生命周期中的核心参考文档 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] ，并且目前仍在很大程度上由手工绘制 [ 7 , 10 ] 。 这些文档相互依赖，但依赖关系很少被记录。 这意味着某一处的更改（例如更高的设计产能）会悄无声息地使其他地方的数字失效：在仿真中、图纸中、设备数据中、布置图中、安全分析和物料清单中 [ 11 ] 。 没有任何东西告诉工程师其中哪些失效了。 许多工艺信息也仍然存放在文档中，在评估更改之前必须先将其数字化 [ 12 ] 。 集成信息模型、交换标准和数字主线解决了这一问题的一部分 [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] 。 它们让工具之间可以交换数据。 但它们不会针对整个项目和每一次修订记录哪些结果彼此之间仍然一致、哪些已过时，以及谁审查了什么。

paragraphs.en: AI agents make this problem larger. They produce more proposals and revisions than people can read, and their output can look plausible but still be invalid. Earlier generators of flowsheets and P&IDs, from rule-based systems [ 17 , 10 , 18 ] to learned models [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] , have a related limit: they produce part of a design without the decisions behind it and outside the engineering workflow. As agents propose faster, verification increasingly sets the pace of engineering [ 22 ] .

paragraphs.en: A further question is how agents should be organized. Our earlier review proposed teams of specialized agents, one per discipline, mirroring an engineering organization [ 4 ] . Here we take a different route. Domain knowledge sits in skills and tools, and one general-purpose agent loads what a task needs. A skill is a short instruction file that tells the agent how to perform an engineering task; a tool is a program that performs a calculation or a check. This keeps the engineering knowledge in files that engineers can read, test and version, independently of a particular agent or model, and it reduces the need for coordination between discipline-specific agents, a reported source of failure in multi-agent systems [ 23 ] . Separate sessions are still used where independence helps, as in review. Which option works better is an open question that needs a controlled comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 一个更进一步的问题是，智能体应当如何被组织。 我们先前的综述提出由专业化智能体组成的团队，每个学科一个，以模拟工程组织 [ 4 ] 。 在此我们采取不同的路线。 领域知识存放在技能和工具中，由一个通用智能体加载任务所需的内容。 技能是一份简短的指令文件，告诉智能体如何执行某项工程任务；工具是执行计算或检查的程序。 这样就把工程知识保存在工程师可以阅读、测试和版本控制的文件中，独立于任何特定的智能体或模型，并且减少了学科专用智能体之间协调的需求——这种协调是多智能体系统中已有报道的一类失败来源 [ 23 ] 。 在独立性有益之处仍然使用分离的会话，例如在评审中。 哪种方案效果更好是一个悬而未决的问题，需要通过受控比较来回答。

paragraphs.en: The acceleration that AI agents promise depends on the engineering environment in which they work. We present ChemE-as-Code, an open-source platform that provides such an environment. It implements the Plant-as-Code perspective of Schweidtmann and Demeyer [ 22 ] and extends it from process and plant design to process chemistry, simulation, techno-economic assessment (TEA) and life cycle assessment (LCA); the name stands for treating chemical engineering work as code. Early industrial pilots on individual projects have pointed to substantially faster design iterations [ 22 ] , and ChemE-as-Code makes the approach open, broad and testable. The platform rests on two foundations. First, a plant is one Git repository of linked, machine-readable files, from the design basis (the requirements the plant must meet: product, capacity, feed, site and utilities) to the life cycle inventory. Every revision is checked by programs, and the checks and calculations behind each value are kept with it; we call this record the evidence of a revision. Second, an open set of calculation tools and agent skills spans the scales of chemical engineering, from catalysis and reaction kinetics to plant layout and LCA (Figure 1 ). Agents and engineers work through the same files and command line, and in the proposed workflow a person reviews the evidence before a revision is accepted. We argue that the innovation lies in this combination of capable agents with an engineering environment designed for them. Models will change quickly, but we expect the way agents interact with engineering files, tools, evidence and reviewers to remain relevant.

sents.en: We argue that the innovation lies in this combination of capable agents with an engineering environment designed for them.

paragraphs.en: We ask three questions. RQ1 (representation): can a process project be represented as linked, machine-readable files across disciplines that agents and people edit? RQ2 (verification): do automated checks find inconsistencies, out-of-date results and affected files when the design changes, where do they fall short, and can generated files be regenerated reproducibly? RQ3 (agent-enabled engineering): can a general-purpose agent carry out interconnected engineering tasks with these skills and tools, at what cost and with which limitations? The paper contributes a paradigm for AI-accelerated, human-directed Chemical Engineering-as-Code, described as five shifts in how engineering work is organized (Section 3 ); the open-source platform that implements it (Section 4 ); and an end-to-end demonstration on a natural-gas ammonia plant with an evaluation of what the checks find and miss (Section 5 ). The case shows that the workflow runs. It does not establish the quality of the design or a productivity gain, which remains our hypothesis.

paragraphs.en: Simulation, flowsheeting, optimization and synthesis are the foundations of PSE [ 24 ] , and connecting the information they produce is an old goal of the field [ 25 ] . Integrated models for data and documents [ 13 ] and the OntoCAPE ontology [ 14 , 26 ] make process engineering knowledge machine-readable and reusable. Knowledge graphs now link process knowledge, models and the origin of data in digital twins [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] . Information technology for integrated process and plant design [ 30 ] , the digitization of legacy drawings [ 12 ] and the digital thread in manufacturing [ 16 ] pursue the same aim. Model-based systems engineering and life cycle standards make traceability and configuration management explicit practice [ 31 , 32 ] , and design research has studied how a change to one component propagates through a product’s structure [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 模拟、流程搭建、优化与综合是过程系统工程（PSE）的基础[24]，而将这些工作所产生的信息连接起来是该领域由来已久的目标[25]。 面向数据和文档的集成模型[13]以及 OntoCAPE 本体[14,26]使过程工程知识变得机器可读且可复用。 知识图谱如今已在数字孪生中将过程知识、模型与数据来源关联起来[27,28,29]。 面向集成过程与工厂设计的信息技术[30]、老旧图纸的数字化[12]以及制造业中的数字主线[16]都追求同样的目标。 基于模型的系统工程和生命周期标准使可追溯性与配置管理成为明确的实践[31,32]，而设计研究已探讨了针对某一组件的变更如何在产品结构中传播[11]。

paragraphs.en: In industrial practice, engineering document management systems (EDMS) control the revision, approval status and distribution of documents over a plant’s life cycle [ 33 ] . Data-centric engineering databases keep P&IDs, equipment and instrument lists in one store, so that the tags and connections on a drawing agree with the lists as long as both are edited in that tool [ 30 , 34 ] . These systems solve part of the version and dependency problem. However, an EDMS tracks documents rather than their content: it records which revision of a P&ID is current, not whether that revision agrees with the instrument list or the simulation. Consistency in integrated tools ends at the tool boundary, and much of the information gathered in design does not reach operation in electronic and interoperable form [ 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在工业实践中，工程文档管理系统（EDMS）在工厂整个生命周期内控制文档的版本、审批状态和分发 [ 33 ] 。 以数据为中心的工程数据库将管道与仪表流程图（P&ID）、设备清单和仪表清单保存在同一个存储中，因此只要图纸和清单都在该工具中编辑，图纸上的位号和连接就与清单保持一致 [ 30 , 34 ] 。 这些系统解决了版本和依赖问题的部分内容。 然而，EDMS 跟踪的是文档而非其内容：它记录的是某个 P&ID 的哪个版本是当前版本，而不是该版本是否与仪表清单或仿真结果一致。 集成工具中的一致性止步于工具边界，设计中收集的大量信息并未以电子且可互操作的形式传递到运行阶段 [ 34 ] 。

paragraphs.en: P&ID data usually sit in proprietary formats of computer-aided engineering tools. DEXPI, based on ISO 15926 [ 35 ] , defines a vendor-independent information model and XML exchange format for P&IDs and process models [ 15 ] . Version 2.0.1 covers block flow diagrams (BFDs), PFDs and P&IDs [ 36 ] and is the format ChemE-as-Code stores. pyDEXPI makes DEXPI data available to Python and to machine learning as graphs [ 37 ] , so that DEXPI can act as the interface between generative models and industrial tools; graph learning on DEXPI plant topologies [ 38 ] and large language model (LLM) interaction with P&IDs [ 39 , 29 ] build on it. CAPE-OPEN makes unit operations and property packages interoperable between process simulators [ 40 ] , AutomationML exchanges engineering data in automation engineering [ 41 ] , and building engineering has open, version-controlled common data environments such as Speckle [ 42 ] . However, standards solve exchange, not revision consistency. A valid DEXPI file says nothing about whether the equipment list, the simulation or the HAZOP study still agrees with it. This means that a standard can carry a design between tools, but it cannot tell an engineer what a change has invalidated.

paragraphs.en: AI in process engineering is starting to move from generators toward LLM agents, although these are still first works, and most methods address one document or one task at a time. The field reaches from expert systems, including knowledge-based P&ID configuration [ 17 , 10 , 18 ] , through machine learning in PSE [ 43 , 44 , 45 ] , to generative AI and LLMs [ 1 , 2 ] , which need to be grounded in domain knowledge [ 46 ] . For flowsheets and P&IDs, prior work has produced text representations [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] , generative models that complete flowsheets and propose control structures [ 19 , 20 , 50 , 51 ] , and rule-based and learned methods that detect and correct errors [ 52 , 21 , 53 , 54 ] . Open engineering data are scarce [ 55 , 56 ] , and generative models produce topologies without the attributes and decisions behind them, are scored against a single reference design although several designs can be valid, and are not integrated into engineering workflows. More recently, LLM agents carry out engineering tasks with tools, from process improvement, optimization and control [ 57 , 58 , 59 ] to P&ID generation [ 60 , 61 ] , simulation and model generation [ 62 , 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 ] , conceptual separation design [ 4 ] and question answering on P&IDs [ 39 , 29 ] . Most use task-specific tools with little human oversight [ 4 ] . Some recent work connects several tasks. Laub et al. digitize process descriptions into flowsheets and build converged Aspen Plus simulations, benchmarked against flowsheets from 50 experts [ 65 ] . Tian et al. go from textual specifications to executable process simulations with a multi-agent workflow [ 66 ] , and Zhang et al. combine a knowledge graph with agents to assemble and calibrate process models for digital twins [ 28 ] . These works stop at flowsheets, simulations and process models; they do not manage and verify revisions across the further disciplines of a plant project. Beyond chemical engineering, tool-augmented agents plan and run chemistry experiments [ 3 , 67 ] , software-engineering agents work through agent–computer interfaces [ 68 ] and are evaluated on real repository issues [ 69 ] , and multi-agent frameworks coordinate several LLM agents on one task [ 70 , 71 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 过程工程中的人工智能正开始从生成器转向基于大语言模型的智能体，尽管这些仍属于早期工作，且大多数方法一次只处理一份文档或一项任务。 该领域从包括基于知识的P&ID配置的专家系统[17, 10, 18]，到过程系统工程中的机器学习[43, 44, 45]，再到生成式人工智能与大语言模型[1, 2]，后者需要以领域知识为支撑[46]。 对于流程图和P&ID，已有工作产出了文本表示[47, 48, 49]、能够补全流程图并提出控制结构的生成式模型[19, 20, 50, 51]，以及用于检测并纠正错误的基于规则的方法和基于学习的方法[52, 21, 53, 54]。 开放的工程数据稀缺[55, 56]，生成式模型产出的拓扑结构缺乏其背后的属性与决策依据，虽然多种设计都可能有效却仅以单一参考设计进行评分，且未被集成到工程工作流中。 近来，智能体借助工具执行工程任务，涵盖从过程改进、优化与控制[57, 58, 59]，到P&ID生成[60, 61]、仿真与模型生成[62, 63, 64, 65, 66]、概念分离设计[4]以及P&ID问答[39, 29]。 大多数智能体使用任务专用工具，且几乎没有人监督[4]。 一些近期工作将多项任务串联起来。 Laub等人将过程描述数字化为流程图并构建收敛的Aspen Plus仿真，以50位专家的流程图作为基准进行评估[65]。 Tian等人通过多智能体工作流从文本规格说明生成可执行的过程仿真[66]，Zhang等人则将知识图谱与智能体相结合，为数字孪生组装和校准过程模型[28]。 这些工作止步于流程图、仿真和过程模型；它们并未在工厂项目的其他后续学科中管理和验证变更。 在化学工程之外，工具增强的智能体能够规划并运行化学实验[3, 67]，软件工程智能体通过智能体—计算机接口开展工作[68]并在真实仓库议题上接受评估[69]，多智能体框架则协调多个智能体完成同一任务[70, 71]。

sents.zh: 开放的工程数据稀缺[55, 56]，生成式模型产出的拓扑结构缺乏其背后的属性与决策依据，虽然多种设计都可能有效却仅以单一参考设计进行评分，且未被集成到工程工作流中。

sents.en: More recently, LLM agents carry out engineering tasks with tools, from process improvement, optimization and control [ 57 , 58 , 59 ] to P&ID generation [ 60 , 61 ] , simulation and model generation [ 62 , 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 ] , conceptual separation design [ 4 ] and question answering on P&IDs [ 39 , 29 ] .
sents.zh: 近来，智能体借助工具执行工程任务，涵盖从过程改进、优化与控制[57, 58, 59]，到P&ID生成[60, 61]、仿真与模型生成[62, 63, 64, 65, 66]、概念分离设计[4]以及P&ID问答[39, 29]。

sents.en: Most use task-specific tools with little human oversight [ 4 ] .
sents.zh: 大多数智能体使用任务专用工具，且几乎没有人监督[4]。

sents.en: Some recent work connects several tasks.
sents.zh: 一些近期工作将多项任务串联起来。

sents.en: Laub et al. digitize process descriptions into flowsheets and build converged Aspen Plus simulations, benchmarked against flowsheets from 50 experts [ 65 ] .
sents.zh: Laub等人将过程描述数字化为流程图并构建收敛的Aspen Plus仿真，以50位专家的流程图作为基准进行评估[65]。

sents.en: Tian et al. go from textual specifications to executable process simulations with a multi-agent workflow [ 66 ] , and Zhang et al. combine a knowledge graph with agents to assemble and calibrate process models for digital twins [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: Tian等人通过多智能体工作流从文本规格说明生成可执行的过程仿真[66]，Zhang等人则将知识图谱与智能体相结合，为数字孪生组装和校准过程模型[28]。

sents.en: These works stop at flowsheets, simulations and process models; they do not manage and verify revisions across the further disciplines of a plant project.
sents.zh: 这些工作止步于流程图、仿真和过程模型；它们并未在工厂项目的其他后续学科中管理和验证变更。

sents.en: Beyond chemical engineering, tool-augmented agents plan and run chemistry experiments [ 3 , 67 ] , software-engineering agents work through agent–computer interfaces [ 68 ] and are evaluated on real repository issues [ 69 ] , and multi-agent frameworks coordinate several LLM agents on one task [ 70 , 71 ] .
sents.zh: 在化学工程之外，工具增强的智能体能够规划并运行化学实验[3, 67]，软件工程智能体通过智能体—计算机接口开展工作[68]并在真实仓库议题上接受评估[69]，多智能体框架则协调多个智能体完成同一任务[70, 71]。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering manages change through version control, continuous integration and delivery [ 72 ] , and Infrastructure-as-Code applies the same practice to computing infrastructure [ 73 ] . Engineering-as-Code transfers it to engineering design [ 74 ] . In plant and automation engineering, industrial practice came first: Davy Demeyer’s Design-Ops work applied Engineering-as-Code and agentic practices before this work [ 75 , 22 ] , and early industrial pilots on individual projects point to substantially faster design iterations [ 22 ] . These pilots use closed software and their details are confidential, so their scope and results cannot be examined or reproduced. Plant-as-Code, proposed by Schweidtmann and Demeyer [ 22 ] , provides a perspective on Engineering-as-Code for process plants.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程通过版本控制、持续集成与交付 [ 72 ] 来管理变更，而基础设施即代码将同样的实践应用于计算基础设施 [ 73 ] 。 工程即代码将其移植到工程设计领域 [ 74 ] 。 在工厂与自动化工程领域，工业实践先行：Davy Demeyer 的 Design-Ops 工作在本研究之前就已应用了工程即代码与智能体实践 [ 75 , 22 ] ，并且在单个项目上的早期工业试点表明设计迭代速度显著加快 [ 22 ] 。 这些试点使用封闭软件且其细节保密，因此其范围与结果无法被检验或复现。 由 Schweidtmann 和 Demeyer 提出的工厂即代码 [ 22 ] ，为工艺工厂领域的工程即代码提供了一个视角。

paragraphs.en: Engineering results can only be trusted if a reader can see where a value came from and can regenerate it. Computational science has practices for this. Rules for reproducible research [ 76 ] and the FAIR principles [ 77 ] describe how to keep data and code findable and reusable, containers fix the software environment [ 78 ] , and reproducible builds require that the same inputs yield outputs that are identical to the byte [ 79 ] . W3C PROV-O provides a vocabulary for recording which activity and which agent produced a result [ 80 ] . In engineering projects, by contrast, whether a value was given by a supplier, assumed by an engineer or calculated by a tool is often recorded only in documents, and a result often cannot be regenerated after a change.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当读者能够看到某个数值的来源并能够重新生成它时，工程结果才是可信的。 计算科学在这方面已有相关实践。 可复现研究规则 [ 76 ] 与 FAIR 原则 [ 77 ] 描述了如何保持数据和代码可查找、可复用，容器用于固定软件环境 [ 78 ] ，而可复现构建要求相同的输入产生逐字节完全相同的输出 [ 79 ] 。 W3C PROV-O 提供了一种词汇表，用于记录是哪个活动、哪个智能体产生了某个结果 [ 80 ] 。 相比之下，在工程项目中，某个数值是由供应商给出、由工程师假设还是由工具计算得到的，通常只记录在文档中，而且在发生变更后结果往往无法重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, prior work provides rigorous models, shared semantics, portable formats, fast generation and the software practice for managing change. ChemE-as-Code brings them into one open project in which every revision is checked across disciplines and kept with its evidence, with tools and skills that let agents work across the scales of chemical engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，先前的工作提供了严谨的模型、共享的语义、可移植的格式、快速的生成以及管理变更的软件实践。 ChemE-as-Code 将它们整合到一个开放项目中，其中每一次修订都经过跨学科校验并与证据一同保存，同时借助工具和技能让智能体能够跨越化学工程的各个尺度开展工作。

paragraphs.en: Chemical Engineering-as-Code changes how engineering work is organized, not what engineers calculate. It extends Plant-as-Code beyond the plant to the whole discipline, including process chemistry, simulation and LCA. We describe this change as five shifts. Each has a counterpart in software development [ 72 , 68 ] , which we use as an analogy: what transfers is the way work is organized, not the nature of the product. Figure 2 shows one iteration of the resulting workflow for a capacity change, the example we use throughout: the plant is to make 20% more product, so the feed, the balances, the equipment, the drawings, the safety study and the inventory all have to follow.
paragraphs.zh: 化工工程即代码（Chemical Engineering-as-Code）改变的是工程工作的组织方式，而不是工程师计算的内容。 它将工厂即代码（Plant-as-Code）从工厂扩展到整个学科，包括过程化学、模拟和生命周期评估（LCA）。 我们将这一变革描述为五个转变。 每一个转变在软件开发中都有对应物 [ 72 , 68 ] ，我们以此作类比：可迁移的是工作的组织方式，而不是产品的性质。 图 2 展示了产能变更所得工作流的一次迭代，这是我们全文使用的示例：工厂要多生产 20% 的产品，因此进料、平衡、设备、图纸、安全研究和库存都必须随之更新。

sents.zh: 化工工程即代码（Chemical Engineering-as-Code）改变的是工程工作的组织方式，而不是工程师计算的内容。

sents.zh: 我们将这一变革描述为五个转变。

paragraphs.en: (i) From documents to connected engineering knowledge. Today, a project is a set of deliverables, each made in its own tool and passed on as a document. In the new paradigm, the design basis, models, drawings, lists, layouts, safety studies and assessments form one connected body of machine-readable knowledge, together with the decisions and evidence behind them. The software analogy is source code and configuration kept as text in one repository, as in Infrastructure-as-Code [ 73 ] . The difference is that drawings and documents do not disappear: they remain as views of the knowledge, issued when a stage requires them. Not every model has to become executable code, but the representations, decisions and dependencies that engineering work needs must be readable, changeable and checkable by people and programs alike. For the engineer, this means that a pump can be followed from the flowsheet to the P&ID, the equipment list and the HAZOP study, which an assistant bound to one tool cannot do [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: （一）从文档到互联的工程知识。 如今，一个项目是一组交付物，每项交付物都在各自的工具中制作，并以文档形式传递。 在新范式下，设计依据、模型、图纸、清单、布置图、安全研究和评估，连同其背后的决策与证据，共同构成一个互联的、机器可读的知识整体。 软件领域的类比是像基础设施即代码那样，将源代码和配置以文本形式保存在同一个代码仓库中 [ 73 ] 。 不同之处在于，图纸和文档并不会消失：它们仍然作为知识的视图存在，在某个阶段需要时发布。 并非每个模型都必须变成可执行的代码，但工程工作所需的表示、决策和依赖关系，必须能被人和程序同样地读取、修改和检查。 对工程师而言，这意味着一台泵可以从工艺流程图追踪到管道与仪表图、设备清单和 HAZOP 研究，这是绑定在单一工具上的智能体无法做到的 [ 22 ] 。

sents.zh: （一）从文档到互联的工程知识。

paragraphs.en: (ii) From manual execution to human-directed agentic engineering. Engineers have so far carried out most engineering activities themselves, with tools for individual calculations. Now they have started to direct some workflows instead. They state objectives, constraints, specifications and acceptance criteria, and agents draft, calculate, revise and document, using deterministic engineering tools for every calculated number. The analogy is a developer who directs coding agents that open pull requests for review. The difference is where responsibility sits: in engineering, the engineer keeps the responsibility for the design, so an agent’s draft is a proposal until a person accepts it. Engineers can then spend more of their time on alternatives, critical decisions and review. If a first draft becomes cheap, a broader exploration of design alternatives may become affordable.
paragraphs.zh: （ii）从人工执行转向由人主导的智能体工程。 迄今为止，工程师大多亲自动手完成大部分工程活动，仅在个别计算上借助工具。 如今，他们已开始转而主导部分工作流程。 他们提出目标、约束、规范和验收标准，而智能体负责起草、计算、修改和记录，每个计算出的数字都使用确定性工程工具得出。 这好比一位开发者指挥编写代码的智能体并让其提交拉取请求以供审查。 区别在于责任所在：在工程领域，工程师始终承担设计责任，因此智能体的草稿在被某人接受之前只是提案。 这样，工程师就能把更多时间花在备选方案、关键决策和审查上。 如果第一版草稿变得廉价，那么对设计备选方案进行更广泛的探索或许就变得可以承受了。

paragraphs.en: (iii) From isolated deliverables to continuously evolving projects. A deliverable is issued at the end of a phase and revised in the next. In Chemical Engineering-as-Code, people and agents change a shared project in small revisions. A revision is one recorded change with its reason, and it can span process, equipment, piping, control, safety and assessment at once. The history of the design, and why it took its present form, stays with the design. The analogy is small, reviewed commits with a recorded history instead of a release at the end of a development phase. The difference is that the engineering phases from concept to detailed engineering remain, with their formal releases and approvals; what can become much shorter are the iterations within them [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: (iii) 从孤立的交付物到持续演进的项目。 交付物在一个阶段结束时发布，并在下一阶段中进行修订。 在“代码化化学工程”中，人与智能体通过小的修订共同修改一个共享的项目。 一次修订是一条带有其原因的已记录变更，并且它可以同时横跨工艺、设备、管道、控制、安全和评估。 设计的历史，以及设计为何呈现当前形态的原因，始终与设计本身相伴。 这一类比是：采用带有记录历史的小型、经评审的提交，而不是在开发阶段结束时才进行一次发布。 不同之处在于，从概念到详细工程的各个工程阶段仍然保留，并保留其正式发布和审批；可以变得短得多的是这些阶段内部的迭代 [ 22 ] 。

sents.en: The difference is that the engineering phases from concept to detailed engineering remain, with their formal releases and approvals; what can become much shorter are the iterations within them [ 22 ] .
sents.zh: 不同之处在于，从概念到详细工程的各个工程阶段仍然保留，并保留其正式发布和审批；可以变得短得多的是这些阶段内部的迭代 [ 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: (iv) From periodic checking to continuous verification. Checks are traditionally tied to milestones such as design reviews and HAZOP studies. Agents, however, can propose revisions faster than anyone can check them [ 22 ] , so milestone checks cannot keep up, and verification has to move into every iteration. A check is a program that tests one rule over the files, for example that every instrument on a P&ID is in the instrument list, and reports a finding with the file and line where the rule fails. Agents repair findings before a person looks at the revision, and every revision carries its evidence: the results of the checks and the calculations behind its values. The analogy is automated tests and continuous integration, which run on every commit. The speed of this loop depends on how cheap, local and trustworthy the checks are. Three states of work are kept apart. A proposed revision is what a person or agent has drafted. A checked revision has no error-level findings; its remaining warnings and the requirements that cannot yet be checked are stated with it. An approved revision has been accepted by a responsible engineer. The difference from software is firm: checks never replace approval, which is given by people, and a HAZOP study still needs a team.

paragraphs.en: When such projects are open and interoperable, engineering knowledge can accumulate. Designs, models, decisions and evidence that are today rebuilt within each organization could be inspected, reused and extended by others, and work at scales that were impractical, such as broad searches over design alternatives or the reassessment of many designs when a shared assumption changes, could become possible (Section 6 ). These shifts do not depend on a particular technology. Version control, plain-text formats, exchange standards such as DEXPI and today’s agents are implementation choices. The paradigm is that engineering knowledge is accessible to computational agents in a shared environment where every action is traceable, every result can be checked, and people decide.
paragraphs.zh: 当这类项目是开放的且可互操作时，工程知识就能不断积累。 如今在每个组织内部重新构建的设计、模型、决策和证据，可以被他人检视、复用和扩展，而过去不切实际的大规模工作，例如对设计备选方案的广泛搜索，或当某个共享假设发生变化时对众多设计的重新评估，也可能变得可行（见第 6 节）。 这些转变并不依赖于某项特定技术。 版本控制、纯文本格式、诸如 DEXPI 的交换标准以及今天的智能体，都只是实现上的选择。 这一范式的核心是：工程知识在共享环境中对计算智能体可访问，在该环境中每个操作都可追溯，每个结果都可校验，而由人来决策。

paragraphs.en: The platform consists of three open repositories. The core is the toolkit: its cheme command validates, formats, renders, compares and generates engineering files, and it includes the skills that instruct agents and a browser viewer ( cheme serve ). The project template is the starting layout for a new plant repository. The process library holds complete plants, including the case study of this paper. A plant is one Git repository of plain files for every discipline, from the design basis through process, equipment, piping, control, safety and layout to cost and the life cycle inventory (LCI), which engineers and agents edit and the core reads, checks and extends (Figure 3 ). This means that an agent sees the whole plant at once, as a coding agent sees a whole software repository rather than one file [ 68 , 69 ] . A change across disciplines is one revision, reviewed as one diff and reverted as a whole, and the checks compare files of the same revision with each other. Large software organizations keep most of their code in a single repository for related reasons, namely unified versioning and atomic changes across projects [ 81 ] . At version 1.1.0 the core comprises about 143,000 lines of Python with about 3,000 test functions. SI Section S2 gives its detailed architecture, and SI Section S4 lists its tools and skills by scale.
paragraphs.zh: 该平台由三个开放仓库组成。 核心是工具包：其 cheme 命令可对工程文件进行校验、格式化、渲染、比较和生成，并且它包含指导智能体的技能和一个浏览器查看器（cheme serve）。 项目模板是一个新装置仓库的起始布局。 过程库保存完整的装置，包括本文的案例研究。 一个装置是一个包含纯文本文件的 Git 仓库，涵盖所有专业的文件，从设计基础，经过工艺、设备、管道、控制、安全和布置，直到成本和生命周期清单（LCI），由工程师和智能体编辑，由核心读取、检查和扩展（图 3）。 这意味着智能体可以一眼看到整个装置，就像编码智能体看到整个软件仓库而不是单个文件一样 [68, 69]。 跨专业的修改是一次修订，作为一个差异进行评审，并作为一个整体回退，且各项检查会对同一修订的文件进行相互比较。 大型软件组织出于类似的原因，即统一版本控制和跨项目的原子性修改，将其大部分代码保存在单一仓库中 [81]。 在 1.1.0 版本中，核心由约 143,000 行 Python 代码组成，包含约 3,000 个测试函数。 SI 第 S2 节给出了其详细架构，SI 第 S4 节按规模列出了其工具和技能。

paragraphs.en: Git keeps versions of files and records who changed what, when and why. It does not know what the files mean. Git does not distinguish a pump from a pipe, and it merges text without regard to engineering meaning, so two revisions that are each consistent can merge into one that is not. Suppose one revision renames pump P-301A to P-303A in the equipment list, and another, made in parallel, adds a line to P-301A on the P&ID. Git merges both without complaint, and the merged state names a pump on the P&ID that the list no longer has. ChemE-as-Code adds the engineering meaning that Git lacks. Each file declares its kind and the schema it follows, items refer to each other by tag (the number of a piece of equipment or a line, such as H-101 or NG-1003), and the checks run on every proposed revision in continuous integration. In the example, cheme validate reports that the P&ID refers to a tag that is not in the equipment list, with the file and the line, before the revision can be accepted.

paragraphs.en: The following standards and formats are used. P&IDs are stored in DEXPI 2.0.1 [ 15 ] , based on ISO 15926, and handled with pyDEXPI [ 37 ] ; the BFD and PFD are generated as DEXPI process models from the flowsheet. All other engineering information is held in YAML files, each validated against a versioned JSON Schema that the file declares; the declaration is added to older files by cheme migrate , the mechanism through which files will move to later schema versions. Decisions are kept in a decision log ( DESIGN.md ), reviews as Markdown records, and stage sign-offs in a generated status file. Three properties make these files suitable for agents and for review. They are canonical : cheme fmt writes DEXPI XML with a readable identifier on every object, so that a P&ID sheet of tens of thousands of lines still yields a small, reviewable diff. They are linked : list items refer to P&ID objects by their tags, flowsheet nodes link to equipment and sheets, and HAZOP studies record the revision of the sheets they analyzed. Relations are recorded only where a check needs them, not in a universal object model, so an ontology, a knowledge graph or an EDMS can be built from a plant repository. They are typed : every YAML kind has a schema, so a wrong unit or a missing field is a finding, not a surprise downstream.

paragraphs.en: The files at one commit are the engineering state of the plant and its source of truth. A person or an agent changes it by proposing a revision, normally on a branch, which becomes the next state once accepted in review and merged. Such an acceptance lets a change merge; it is not the approval of a responsible engineer.
paragraphs.zh: 单一提交中的文件即工厂的工程状态及其事实来源。 人或智能体通过提出修订来更改它，通常在分支上进行，修订在评审中被接受并合并后即成为下一个状态。 在所提出的工作流程中，接受是人的决定，且变更由评审者而非作者合并；平台尚未强制执行这一点，但 Git 托管平台上的分支保护可以做到。 在案例研究（第 5 节）中，一个评审智能体接受了变更，因此该设计是由智能体生成的，包含作者被记录的干预措施，且没有独立的人工评审。 这样的接受只是让变更得以合并，并非责任工程师的批准。

paragraphs.en: Every file is either authoritative or derived . Authoritative files are written by people or agents: the design basis, given and assumed values, P&IDs, lists, layout inputs, HAZOP records, decisions and reviews. Derived files are generated by a tool: the BFD and PFD from the flowsheet, simulation runs and calculated values, the 3D plant model, the material take-off (MTO), estimates and LCI datasets. Derived files are never edited by hand. Where implemented, they record a fingerprint of their inputs and the version of the tool that generated them, and cheme validate reports a file or value whose inputs no longer match as out of date, as it reports a hand edit of a generated sheet. A calculated value never overwrites a given or assumed one: a tool writes only the values it calculated itself, so if a given flow no longer closes a balance, a check reports the imbalance instead of a tool correcting the input. Nothing is regenerated, rewritten or declared invalid automatically. A derived file stays as it is, marked out of date, until a person or agent runs the command that regenerates it, and regenerating it with the same inputs and the same tool version gives output that is identical to the byte (SI Section S4).
paragraphs.zh: 每个文件要么是权威文件，要么是派生文件。 权威文件由人或智能体编写：设计依据、给定值和假设值、P&ID、清单、布置输入、HAZOP 记录、决策和评审。 派生文件由工具生成：来自流程图的 BFD 和 PFD、模拟运行和计算值、工厂三维模型、材料表（MTO）、估算以及 LCI 数据集。 派生文件绝不经手工编辑。 在实现此机制之处，它们会记录其输入的指纹以及生成它们的工具版本，cheme validate 会像报告对生成工作表的手工编辑那样，将输入不再匹配的文件或值报告为已过期。 计算值绝不会覆盖给定值或假设值：工具只写入它自己计算出的值，因此如果某个给定流量不再能使平衡闭合，检查会报告该不平衡，而不是由工具去修正输入。 任何内容都不会被自动重新生成、重写或宣布为无效。 派生文件保持原样并被标记为已过期，直到人或智能体运行重新生成它的命令，并且使用相同输入和相同工具版本重新生成时，得到的输出与原输出逐字节完全一致（SI 第 S4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The core separates what agents propose from what tools compute. The core’s own tools cover what sits between them: balances and propagation, shortcut sizing of exchangers, pumps, compressors and columns, the 3D model with pipe routing and clash detection, HAZOP rating, cost estimation from published correlations, and TEA. SI Section S4 lists them by scale.

paragraphs.en: The agent’s interface is the command line and the files themselves, the same interface a software engineer uses. The loop is simple. The agent edits a file, runs cheme fmt and cheme validate , reads the findings, fixes what they report, and validates again. Each finding is one line with a stable identifier, the rule, a severity, the file and, where one applies, the line, and a hint. An agent can therefore act on a finding as it would on a failing test. The engineer sees the same lines in continuous integration and in the viewer.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的接口是命令行和文件本身，与软件工程师使用的接口相同。这个循环很简单。 智能体编辑一个文件，运行 cheme fmt 和 cheme validate，阅读检查结果，修复其中报告的问题，然后再次校验。 每条检查结果都是一行，包含一个稳定的标识符、规则、严重级别、文件名，以及适用的行号和一条提示。 因此，智能体可以像处理失败的测试一样处理一条检查结果。 工程师在持续集成和查看器中看到的是同样的内容。

paragraphs.en: Skills carry the engineering procedure. A skill is a short instruction file in the plant repository that tells the agent which inputs a task needs, how to carry it out, which tools to call, and which decisions are left to people. The 109 skills of version 1.1.0 span the scales of a project, from component properties and reaction kinetics through thermodynamic-model selection, flowsheet simulation and reactor screening to equipment sizing, P&ID authoring, control, 3D layout, HAZOP, cost estimation, TEA and LCA. About half of them are process knowledge: unit operations, utilities, heat integration, and the technologies of gas processing, refining, petrochemicals and heavy chemicals.

paragraphs.en: The skill for selecting a thermodynamic model shows the division of labor between skill, tool and person. It is used before any phase calculation and before a property method is recorded in the materials file. The skill tells the agent to establish the facts first: the pressure range, whether the mixture is polar, whether electrolytes are present, whether interaction parameters are available, and whether a second liquid phase or vapor association is expected. The agent fills in only what the given information or well-established chemistry supports and leaves the rest unset. The tool behind the skill is a rule engine that implements Carlson’s published decision tree. If a fact it needs is missing, it refuses and names the missing fact as a question, which the agent answers or escalates. The result is a recommendation with its reasoning, recorded with provenance, and the skill states that it is not a validated choice. In the ammonia case, this skill recommended a predictive equation of state or a cubic equation of state with Huron–Vidal mixing rules for the polar loop mixture at 155 bar. The simulation route could not run either, so the agents used Peng–Robinson as a substitute and recorded the decision, and the calculation maturity later reported these mixtures as outside the benchmarked range of the method (SI Section S8). The HAZOP skill works in the same way: it drafts nodes, deviations and safeguards, the rating tool looks up the risk band in the matrix, and every entry stays marked as proposed until a HAZOP team accepts it.
paragraphs.zh: 选择热力学模型的技能展示了技能、工具与人员之间的分工。 它在任何相计算之前、以及在物性方法被记录到物料文件之前使用。 该技能指示智能体先确立事实：压力范围、混合物是否极性、是否存在电解质、是否有可用的相互作用参数、以及是否预期出现第二液相或汽相缔合。 智能体只填写已有信息或成熟化学知识所能支持的内容，其余保持未设定状态。 该技能背后的工具是一个实现 Carlson 已发表决策树的规则引擎。 如果所需的事实缺失，它会拒绝执行，并将缺失的事实作为问题提出，由智能体回答或上报。 其结果是附带推理的建议，并连同出处记录在案，且该技能声明这并非经过验证的选择。 在氨的案例中，该技能针对 155 bar 下的极性环路混合物推荐了预测型状态方程或采用 Huron–Vidal 混合规则的立方型状态方程。 仿真路线也无法运行，因此智能体改用 Peng–Robinson 作为替代并记录了该决定，而计算成熟度工具随后报告这些混合物超出了该方法的基准适用范围（SI 第 S8 节）。 HAZOP 技能以同样的方式工作：它起草节点、偏差与防护措施，评级工具在矩阵中查找风险区间，且每一条目在被 HAZOP 团队接受之前都保持“建议”标记。

sents.zh: 选择热力学模型的技能展示了技能、工具与人员之间的分工。

sents.en: It is used before any phase calculation and before a property method is recorded in the materials file.
sents.zh: 它在任何相计算之前、以及在物性方法被记录到物料文件之前使用。

sents.en: The skill tells the agent to establish the facts first: the pressure range, whether the mixture is polar, whether electrolytes are present, whether interaction parameters are available, and whether a second liquid phase or vapor association is expected.
sents.zh: 该技能指示智能体先确立事实：压力范围、混合物是否极性、是否存在电解质、是否有可用的相互作用参数、以及是否预期出现第二液相或汽相缔合。

sents.en: The agent fills in only what the given information or well-established chemistry supports and leaves the rest unset.
sents.zh: 智能体只填写已有信息或成熟化学知识所能支持的内容，其余保持未设定状态。

sents.en: The tool behind the skill is a rule engine that implements Carlson’s published decision tree.
sents.zh: 该技能背后的工具是一个实现 Carlson 已发表决策树的规则引擎。

sents.en: If a fact it needs is missing, it refuses and names the missing fact as a question, which the agent answers or escalates.
sents.zh: 如果所需的事实缺失，它会拒绝执行，并将缺失的事实作为问题提出，由智能体回答或上报。

sents.en: The result is a recommendation with its reasoning, recorded with provenance, and the skill states that it is not a validated choice.
sents.zh: 其结果是附带推理的建议，并连同出处记录在案，且该技能声明这并非经过验证的选择。

sents.en: In the ammonia case, this skill recommended a predictive equation of state or a cubic equation of state with Huron–Vidal mixing rules for the polar loop mixture at 155 bar.
sents.zh: 在氨的案例中，该技能针对 155 bar 下的极性环路混合物推荐了预测型状态方程或采用 Huron–Vidal 混合规则的立方型状态方程。

sents.en: The simulation route could not run either, so the agents used Peng–Robinson as a substitute and recorded the decision, and the calculation maturity later reported these mixtures as outside the benchmarked range of the method (SI Section S8).
sents.zh: 仿真路线也无法运行，因此智能体改用 Peng–Robinson 作为替代并记录了该决定，而计算成熟度工具随后报告这些混合物超出了该方法的基准适用范围（SI 第 S8 节）。

sents.en: The HAZOP skill works in the same way: it drafts nodes, deviations and safeguards, the rating tool looks up the risk band in the matrix, and every entry stays marked as proposed until a HAZOP team accepts it.
sents.zh: HAZOP 技能以同样的方式工作：它起草节点、偏差与防护措施，评级工具在矩阵中查找风险区间，且每一条目在被 HAZOP 团队接受之前都保持“建议”标记。

paragraphs.en: This division means that engineering expertise becomes accessible to agents without being embedded in an LLM. The numbers come from tools that can be tested and versioned. The procedures come from skills that engineers can read, review and improve like any other file. The decisions stay with people.

paragraphs.en: Agents produce more revisions than an engineer can read, so the checks tell the engineer where to look and what not to trust yet. Each check tests one rule that a program can decide, in four layers [ 22 ] : every file matches its schema (a design temperature is a number with a unit); files agree with each other (a line’s diameter in the line list matches the P&ID that draws it); balances and simulations hold (every mass balance closes within its tolerance); and selected safety requirements are met (a trip does not share its transmitter with the control loop it protects against). The core defines 466 rules (SI Section S3), and every finding names the file and, where one applies, the line.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体产生的修订版本数量超过工程师所能阅读的量，因此这些检查会告诉工程师该往哪里看、哪些内容暂时不能信任。 每项检查测试一条程序能够判定的规则，共分四层 [ 22 ]：每个文件符合其模式（设计温度是一个带单位的数字）；文件之间相互一致（管线清单中某管线的直径与绘制它的管道仪表流程图相符）；平衡和模拟成立（每个质量平衡都在其容差范围内闭合）；并且选定的安全要求得到满足（一个联锁不会与其所防范的控制回路共用同一个变送器）。 该核心定义了 466 条规则（SI 第 S3 节），并且每条发现都指明文件名，以及（如适用）所在的行。

paragraphs.en: A design change shows how the checks work together. Suppose an agent raises the design capacity by 20% and the feed flows with it. The balance rules report that the flowsheet no longer closes; every calculated result whose input dependencies are recorded, from stream properties to the simulation run, is reported as out of date through its fingerprint; and cheme impact lists the files and reviews that need attention. Nothing is recalculated on its own. The agent or the engineer reruns the relevant tools and checks whether the affected results are now current, and the reviews that the change made out of date are redone. This sequence (check, identify the affected work, recalculate, review) follows only the dependencies the platform records; a duty copied by hand from the flowsheet into a datasheet is not among them (Section 5.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一次设计变更展示了各项检查如何协同工作。 假设某个智能体将设计产能提高了 20%，进料流量也随之变化。 平衡规则报告该流程图不再闭合；每一个记录了输入依赖关系的计算结果——从物流物性到仿真运行——都通过其指纹被报告为已过期；并且 cheme impact 列出需要关注的文件和评审。 任何内容都不会自行重新计算。 智能体或工程师重新运行相关工具，检查受影响的结果现在是否为最新，并对因该变更而过期的评审进行重做。 这一序列（检查、识别受影响的工作、重新计算、评审）仅遵循平台所记录的依赖关系；人工从流程图抄录到数据表中的数据不在其中（第 5.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: The checks support the decision whether work can proceed to the next project stage; they do not take it. Each stage has gates (Table 1 ), for example that every item on the equipment list has a datasheet marked final, and a stage is signed off only when its gates pass and no serious review finding is open (SI Section S3). The platform also reports calculation maturity, a program-evaluated summary of which calculation requirements have been met (SI Section S3). Passing these requirements establishes only that the conditions encoded in them have been met, not that the design is right or that an engineer has approved it. Approval is reserved for people in the proposed workflow; the core records reviews but does not enforce this, and in the case study it accepted sign-offs on agent reviews.
paragraphs.zh: 这些检查支持关于工作能否进入下一项目阶段的决策，但不代替做出该决策。 每个阶段设有门槛（表 1），例如设备清单中的每一项都有标记为最终版的数据表；只有当某阶段的所有门槛通过且没有未解决的严重审查问题时，该阶段才被签核（SI 第 S3 节）。 该平台还会报告计算成熟度，即对哪些计算要求已经达成所做的项目层面评估摘要（SI 第 S3 节）。 通过这些要求只能表明其中所编码的条件已经满足，并不能表明设计是正确的，也不能表明工程师已经批准。 批准权保留给拟议工作流程中的人员；核心系统记录审查但不强制执行这一点，并且在案例研究中，它接受了智能体审查的签核。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the platform on a natural-gas ammonia plant, following the design from its initial requirements through simulation, engineering documents and safety studies. We chose ammonia because its design couples many disciplines, from reaction equilibria and recycle convergence through equipment, piping, instrumentation and layout to cost estimation. We ask whether agents can use the platform to develop a connected engineering project (RQ1, RQ3), how far the checks identify errors and incomplete changes, whether derived files can be regenerated (RQ2), and whether an agent can revise the plant through the same workflow (RQ2, RQ3). Three kinds of success have to be kept apart: execution, meaning that agents generated and modified a multidisciplinary project; formal verification, meaning that the implemented rules and gates checked the conditions they cover; and engineering correctness, which this case does not establish, because no independent engineer has reviewed the design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个天然气制氨厂上演示了该平台，遵循其设计从最初需求一路推进到仿真、工程文档和安全研究。 我们选择氨是因为其设计耦合了众多学科，从反应平衡和循环收敛，到设备、管道、仪表和布置，再到成本估算。 我们探究智能体能否利用该平台开发一个相互关联的工程项目（RQ1、RQ3），这些检查能在多大程度上识别错误和不完整的变更，派生文件能否被重新生成（RQ2），以及智能体能否通过相同的工作流对该厂进行修订（RQ2、RQ3）。 必须区分三种成功：执行，即智能体生成并修改了一个多学科项目；形式化验证，即所实现的规则和门控检查了它们所覆盖的条件；以及工程正确性，本案例并未确立这一点，因为没有独立工程师对该设计进行过审查。

paragraphs.en: Agents developed the plant in two stages (Table 2 ): a concept stage of three sessions that produced the design basis, a balanced flowsheet and the equipment list, and an engineering stage that started from a written brief by the author (SI Section S5). In the engineering stage, an orchestrating session ran one implementation job per section, each followed by a reviewer job in a separate session that returned the work for correction or merged it once continuous integration had passed. These are workflow roles of one general-purpose agent, not discipline-specific agents. Unlike in the proposed workflow, reviewer agents accepted the changes, so no engineer’s acceptance enters the record. The author’s interventions were the brief, the budget and stop rules, and the decisions the agents escalated (SI Section S9). The evaluations of Section 5.5 ran on the reported state, process-library tag nh3-run-final , where every file of the case is public.

paragraphs.en: The engineering stage turned the concept-stage flowsheet into a connected package: a converged simulation, P&IDs with their lists, control loops and datasheets, a routed 3D layout, a HAZOP study, relief cases, a class 4 estimate with TEA, and an LCI, in one repository whose files refer to each other by tag (Table 2 ). It passed every concept- and basic-stage gate and three of the five detail gates with no error-level finding. Figure 4 follows one piece of equipment, the reformer furnace H-101, through these files: the 3D model, the P&ID, the HAZOP study and the links between them. paragraphs.en: The techno-economic assessment gives a levelized cost of 688 EUR/t against 439 EUR/t assumed for imported ammonia. Under its assumptions, 2025 Dutch industrial energy prices and a US Gulf Coast import price without freight (SI Section S7), the plant would not compete with imports. The LCI records every exchange of the flowsheet per kg of ammonia and gives a gate-to-gate carbon footprint of 1.46 kg CO 2 -eq per kg, with 6% of the burden allocated to the exported steam by exergy. This counts only the plant’s own emissions: the background datasets for natural gas supply, electricity and utilities are deliberately left unlinked as open gaps, so the figure is a screening result, not a cradle-to-gate footprint.

paragraphs.en: Reviewer agents recorded 2 high, 39 medium and 52 low findings in 26 review sessions, and 13 times over 7 review rounds they sent work back for fixing. The findings included engineering defects as well as formal ones: exchangers with a large pressure step between their sides had no tube-rupture case, and heat-transfer coefficients for gases near atmospheric pressure had been used for the 150 bar loop. As the brief required, eight jobs stopped and reported a blocker instead of relaxing a gate. One job, however, marked datasheets final so that a gate would count them, and a reviewer caught this. The run also found eight defects in the platform software, of which three were fixed by agent jobs outside the design (SI Section S9). These reviewers use the same model as the designers and are therefore not independent [ 22 ] .

paragraphs.en: The recorded run used 63 agent sessions at an API cost of USD 255.31 (Table 3 ): USD 12.02 for the concept stage (3 sessions, 40 minutes) and USD 243.30 for the engineering stage (60 sessions, about 27 hours). Layout and its downstream sections took 40% of the design cost and 26 of the 56 design sessions, because they needed the most iteration. Review and fix jobs took about a quarter of the design cost, and nearly half when the close-out jobs (USD 44), which are booked as implementation, are included. These figures describe one execution with a particular model and heavy caching (565 million cached input tokens), on a first-generation toolchain and with a workflow nobody had practiced before. They bound neither the best nor the typical case, and a more mature platform and more practiced briefs will change them. An order-of-magnitude estimate of the inference energy from the recorded tokens and published per-token figures [ 83 , 84 ] is given in SI Section S9. The cost figures exclude the orchestrating session, whose own API cost was not recorded, as well as human expertise, infrastructure and independent review. They are not evidence of productivity compared with an engineering team.

paragraphs.en: To obtain an outside reference, we compared eight of ten planned indicators with the EU reference document on best available techniques (BAT) for ammonia (BREF) [ 85 ] and the International Energy Agency (IEA) ammonia roadmap [ 86 ] (Table 4 ; the two NOx indicators are not modeled, and the net energy appears twice, as delivered and with electricity at an assumed 40% conversion). The reference values were written before the engineering stage and withheld from the design jobs. Overall, the design appears plausible: process CO 2 , loop pressure and conversion per pass lie inside the published ranges, and the energy indicators lie close to them. The comparison is only an indication, for three reasons. First, the references leave their boundaries and conversion factors partly open. The net specific energy is 26.97 GJ/t with electricity counted as delivered and 30.1 GJ/t at an assumed conversion efficiency of 40%, against a BAT range of 27.6–31.8 GJ/t ( ± \pm 1.5 GJ), and the comparison cannot establish whether the design is more or less efficient than a BAT plant. Second, the design imports more electricity than the IEA’s reference plant (2.1 against 0.3 GJ/t), because all its machines are electric, which lowers its natural-gas figure, and its lower steam export is not a merit, since its furnace, steam and refrigeration models are simplified. Third, the comparison was not fully blind, because a design agent opened the BREF during the run. We found no design value that moved toward the reference figures, but we cannot exclude influence (SI Section S11).
paragraphs.zh: 为获得外部参照，我们将十项计划指标中的八项与欧盟氨最佳可行技术（BAT）参考文件（BREF）[ 85 ] 以及国际能源署（IEA）氨路线图 [ 86 ] 进行了比较（表 4 ；其中两项 NOx 指标未建模，净能耗出现两次，一次按交付能源计，一次按假设 40% 的电转换效率计）。 这些参考值在工程设计阶段之前写好，并对设计任务保密。 总体来看，该设计显得合理：工艺 CO 2 、回路压力和单程转化率均落在已发表的范围内，各项能耗指标也接近这些范围。 这一比较仅具指示意义，原因有三。 首先，这些参考文献对其系统边界和转换系数的说明不完全明确。 净比能耗按电力按交付计为 26.97 GJ/t，按假设 40% 的转换效率计为 30.1 GJ/t，而 BAT 范围为 27.6–31.8 GJ/t（ ± \pm 1.5 GJ），因此这一比较无法确定该设计的效率是高于还是低于 BAT 工厂。 其次，该设计进口的电力多于 IEA 参考工厂（2.1 对 0.3 GJ/t），因为其所有机器均为电动，这降低了其天然气数值，而其较低的蒸汽输出并非优点，因为其炉子、蒸汽和制冷模型都经过简化。 第三，这一比较并非完全盲测，因为一个设计智能体在运行过程中打开了 BREF。 我们没有发现任何设计值朝参考数值方向移动，但无法排除其影响（SI 第 S11 节）。

sents.en: To obtain an outside reference, we compared eight of ten planned indicators with the EU reference document on best available techniques (BAT) for ammonia (BREF) [ 85 ] and the International Energy Agency (IEA) ammonia roadmap [ 86 ] (Table 4 ; the two NOx indicators are not modeled, and the net energy appears twice, as delivered and with electricity at an assumed 40% conversion).
sents.zh: 为获得外部参照，我们将十项计划指标中的八项与欧盟氨最佳可行技术（BAT）参考文件（BREF）[ 85 ] 以及国际能源署（IEA）氨路线图 [ 86 ] 进行了比较（表 4 ；其中两项 NOx 指标未建模，净能耗出现两次，一次按交付能源计，一次按假设 40% 的电转换效率计）。

sents.en: The reference values were written before the engineering stage and withheld from the design jobs.
sents.zh: 这些参考值在工程设计阶段之前写好，并对设计任务保密。

sents.en: Overall, the design appears plausible: process CO 2 , loop pressure and conversion per pass lie inside the published ranges, and the energy indicators lie close to them.
sents.zh: 总体来看，该设计显得合理：工艺 CO 2 、回路压力和单程转化率均落在已发表的范围内，各项能耗指标也接近这些范围。

sents.en: The comparison is only an indication, for three reasons.
sents.zh: 这一比较仅具指示意义，原因有三。

sents.en: First, the references leave their boundaries and conversion factors partly open.
sents.zh: 首先，这些参考文献对其系统边界和转换系数的说明不完全明确。

sents.en: The net specific energy is 26.97 GJ/t with electricity counted as delivered and 30.1 GJ/t at an assumed conversion efficiency of 40%, against a BAT range of 27.6–31.8 GJ/t ( ± \pm 1.5 GJ), and the comparison cannot establish whether the design is more or less efficient than a BAT plant.
sents.zh: 净比能耗按电力按交付计为 26.97 GJ/t，按假设 40% 的转换效率计为 30.1 GJ/t，而 BAT 范围为 27.6–31.8 GJ/t（ ± \pm 1.5 GJ），因此这一比较无法确定该设计的效率是高于还是低于 BAT 工厂。

sents.en: Second, the design imports more electricity than the IEA’s reference plant (2.1 against 0.3 GJ/t), because all its machines are electric, which lowers its natural-gas figure, and its lower steam export is not a merit, since its furnace, steam and refrigeration models are simplified.
sents.zh: 其次，该设计进口的电力多于 IEA 参考工厂（2.1 对 0.3 GJ/t），因为其所有机器均为电动，这降低了其天然气数值，而其较低的蒸汽输出并非优点，因为其炉子、蒸汽和制冷模型都经过简化。

sents.en: Third, the comparison was not fully blind, because a design agent opened the BREF during the run.
sents.zh: 第三，这一比较并非完全盲测，因为一个设计智能体在运行过程中打开了 BREF。

sents.en: We found no design value that moved toward the reference figures, but we cannot exclude influence (SI Section S11).
sents.zh: 我们没有发现任何设计值朝参考数值方向移动，但无法排除其影响（SI 第 S11 节）。

paragraphs.en: Planted faults. To see what the checks find, we injected one fault at a time into a copy of the files and ran the checks. We first wrote 19 faults knowing the rules, aimed at schema, consistency, physical, out-of-date and review rules, such as a line enlarged in the line list but not on the P&ID, or a feed temperature changed without rerunning the simulation. All 19 triggered their intended rule, with a finding at the edited file in 12 cases and at the edited line in 10. This confirms that the rules fire on the faults they target, but it says nothing about faults nobody wrote a rule for. We therefore had a separate agent session write 12 further faults on a copy of the engineering files from which the checks, skills and reviews had been removed, so that it could not see the rules. We count a fault as identified when a new finding names the wrong condition itself; a finding that only says that a file changed or that a result is out of date does not count. By this definition, the checks identified 4 of the 12: a mistyped relief-valve tag, a vessel placed on top of another, a hand-edited HAZOP risk band and a trip sharing its transmitter with the control loop. Five raised only a generic change signal, among them a relief valve set above its vessel’s design pressure and plain carbon steel chosen for a − 33 ∘ -33\,^{\circ} C drum. Three raised nothing, including a let-down valve changed to fail open. Four further planted values that were implausible but self-consistent, such as a datasheet pressure off by a factor of ten, also raised only change signals. This means that the checks find what contradicts an implemented rule, but not an error that no rule covers, even when another file states the conflicting value.
paragraphs.zh: 预埋缺陷。 为了查看检查能发现什么，我们每次向文件副本中注入一个缺陷并运行检查。 我们首先在已知规则的情况下编写了 19 个缺陷，针对模式、一致性、物理、过时和评审规则，例如在管线清单中放大了某条管线但未在 P&ID 上放大，或者更改了进料温度却没有重新运行模拟。 全部 19 个缺陷都触发了其目标规则，其中 12 例在编辑的文件处给出发现，10 例在编辑的行处给出发现。 这证实了规则会在其针对的缺陷上触发，但没有说明那些没人为其编写规则的缺陷的情况。 因此，我们让一个单独的智能体会话在工程文件的副本上再编写 12 个缺陷，该副本已移除检查、技能和评审，使其无法看到规则。 当一条新的发现指明了错误条件本身时，我们才将该缺陷计为已识别；仅说明某文件发生了变更或某结果已过时的发现不计入。 按此定义，检查识别出了 12 个中的 4 个：一个输错的安全阀位号、一个叠放在另一设备之上的容器、一个手工修改的 HAZOP 风险等级，以及一个与控制回路共用变送器的联锁。 五个仅触发了笼统的变更信号，其中包括设定压力高于容器设计压力的安全阀，以及为 −33 °C 的储罐选用普通碳钢。 三个未触发任何信号，包括一个被改为故障开启的减压阀。 另有四个被植入的数值不合理但自洽，例如数据表压力偏差了十倍，也仅触发了变更信号。 这意味着检查只能发现与已实现规则相矛盾的问题，而无法发现没有规则覆盖的错误，即使另一份文件中已写明相互矛盾的数值。

paragraphs.en: Engineering changes. To see how far the checks reach, we made five engineering changes on separate copies, from a re-rated pump to a 20% capacity increase, and ran the checks once after each. Beforehand, a separate agent session had listed, for each change, the files it expected to be affected and whether each needed an edit, a regeneration or a review; no engineer has checked these lists, so the numbers are indicative. The checks flagged or named 13 of 22 expected files for a re-tagged pump and 5 of 161 for the capacity increase, and fewer than half for the other three changes. After the capacity increase, the checks raised balance errors, marked the simulation and 105 stream values as out of date, lowered the calculation maturity and refused the PFD rebuild, but they did not flag most downstream disciplines, because the checks stop at the first broken layer until it is repaired. This means that one pass of the checks shows the engineer where to start, not everything a change will touch.
paragraphs.zh: 工程变更。 为了了解检查的覆盖范围，我们在各自独立的副本上做了五项工程变更，从重新定级的泵到 20% 的产能提升，并在每次变更后运行一次检查。 事先，一个单独的智能体会话已针对每项变更列出了其预计会受影响的文件，以及每个文件是需要编辑、重新生成还是审查；没有工程师核对过这些清单，因此这些数字仅供参考。 对于重新定级的泵，检查标记或指出了 22 个预计文件中的 13 个；对于产能提升，是 161 个中的 5 个；对其余三项变更，则都不到一半。 在产能提升之后，检查提出了平衡错误，将仿真和 105 个流股值标记为过期，降低了计算成熟度，并拒绝了 PFD 重建，但它们没有标记大多数下游专业，因为检查在遇到第一个损坏的层时会停止，直到该层被修复。 这意味着检查的一次运行只能告诉工程师从哪里开始，而不是变更会触及的全部内容。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility. We regenerated derived files with fixed software versions. The six generators tested (BFD and PFD, plant model, one P&ID rendering, two datasheet drawings, LCA, MTO), two DWSIM runs and library builds from one commit gave output identical to the byte [ 79 ] . After a feed-temperature change, a 72 s simulation rerun cleared all 106 out-of-date findings. On another operating system, the BFD, PFD, plant model and the two datasheet drawings regenerated identically, whereas the LCA and MTO files differed in their line endings, a defect in the commands that write them. The derived files are therefore reproducible with fixed software versions, apart from these line endings.
paragraphs.zh: 可复现性。 我们使用固定的软件版本重新生成了派生文件。 所测试的六个生成器（BFD 和 PFD、装置模型、一份 P&ID 渲染图、两份数据表图纸、LCA、MTO），以及来自同一提交（commit）的两次 DWSIM 运行和库构建，其输出与原始结果逐字节完全一致 [ 79 ]。 在进料温度改变后，一次 72 秒的仿真重跑清除了全部 106 条过期发现。 在另一个操作系统上，BFD、PFD、装置模型和两份数据表图纸被完全一致地重新生成，而 LCA 和 MTO 文件的换行符有所不同，这是写入这些文件的命令中的一个缺陷。 因此，除这些换行符外，派生文件在固定软件版本下是可复现的。

paragraphs.en: Agent-driven change. Finally, one unattended agent session was asked to raise the capacity to 1,800 t/d and propagate the change as far as it could on a budget described as tight, resolving what the checks report and listing the equipment it judged must be resized, without relaxing a gate or signing off (SI Section S13). In 49 minutes and for USD 8.55 of a USD 19.90 cap, it raised the design capacity and the feed flows, re-simulated the plant to 1,799 t/d with closed balances, and updated control setpoints, datasheet duties, relief loads, the estimate and the LCA; it changed 128 of the 161 files on the expected-impact list. A separate rerun of the checks found 0 errors and 252 warnings, a calculation maturity of balanced , and four failing gates: the two detail gates that had failed before and two reviews that the change had made out of date. Yet the plant was not resized. The flows and duties are 20% larger on paper, but no P&ID or line changed, the equipment dimensions and the layout still describe the 1,500 t/d plant, and 36 lines exceed their design velocities by the agent’s own screening, not by any check, because no rule compares a flow with a line size. The agent reported this and stated that it would not trust its costs. The tight budget may have contributed, so this result does not measure the most that agents can do. The outcome is mixed: an agent carried out substantial cross-disciplinary work through the shared repository, but the checks follow only the dependencies the platform records, so zero errors did not mean that the change was complete, and a reviewer was still needed.

paragraphs.en: AI acceleration and the practice of engineering. In the proposed workflow, agents act on findings, people review a diff with its evidence, and progress is judged by the evidence instead of the number of drawings. We argue that this is the precondition for acceleration: without it, faster drafting only produces more unchecked documents. How much of the acceleration survives review remains unclear. The length of software tasks that agents complete on their own has doubled about every seven months since 2019 [ 6 ] , and most technology professionals report that AI has increased their productivity [ 87 ] , but such gains depend on the task, and this study does not establish a net time saving once engineering review is counted. In the ammonia case, a package that passed the basic-stage gates cost USD 224 in API calls for its design sessions, but its reviewers sent work back 13 times, the last gates needed decisions from a person, and an independent engineer would still have to review the result. We expect the cost of first drafts to fall much faster than the cost of checking and review, which would then set the pace and change what teams must build and education must teach [ 22 ] . Controlled studies against engineering baselines, comparable to SWE-bench for software agents [ 69 ] , are in preparation for process design, HAZOP and other tasks.

paragraphs.en: Known and novel processes. Ammonia from natural gas is among the best-documented processes in chemical engineering, and the route was set in the first task. The case therefore tests whether agents can carry a known process through engineering work consistently, not whether they can conceive a new one. We believe that particular care is needed with novel processes, for three reasons. LLMs draw on published knowledge and may fall back on familiar flowsheets where a different one would be better. New processes lack the kinetic, property and cost data on which the deterministic tools depend, so more of the design rests on assumptions. And the rules and gates encode established practice: they can show that an unconventional design is inconsistent, not that it is good, and they may flag a sound new idea as an error. Cheap and traceable iterations may still help creative work by letting many more alternatives be generated and screened, with people judging which are worth pursuing; testing this needs design tasks on processes published after the model’s knowledge cutoff, or hypothetical routes judged by experts.
paragraphs.zh: 已知工艺与全新工艺。 以天然气制氨是化学工程中文献记载最完善的工艺之一，其路线已在第一项任务中确定。 因此，该案例测试的是智能体能否将一个已知工艺一致地贯穿整个工程工作，而不是它们能否构想出新工艺。 我们认为，对于全新工艺需要特别谨慎，原因有三。 大语言模型依托已发表的知识，在另一种流程图更优的情况下，可能会退回到熟悉的流程图。 新工艺缺乏确定性工具所依赖的动力学、物性和成本数据，因此更多的设计工作只能依靠假设。 而且，这些规则和门控编码的是既有实践：它们能表明一个非传统设计与规范不一致，却不能表明它是否优秀，并且可能把一个合理的新想法标记为错误。 廉价且可追溯的迭代仍可能有助于创造性工作，方法是生成并筛选更多的备选方案，由人来判断哪些值得推进；要验证这一点，需要使用该模型知识截止日期之后发表的工艺设计任务，或由专家评判的假设性路线。

paragraphs.en: Consistent is not correct. Keeping calculations outside the LLM makes them repeatable and testable, but a deterministic calculation with a wrong assumption, an unsuitable property method or an incomplete model gives the same wrong result every time. The ammonia case illustrated this in part: the energy indicators looked favorable until their boundaries were examined, a wrong design value that no rule covers raised no finding that named it, and a capacity change raised no errors although the plant had not been resized. The agents also wrote some of the calculation scripts themselves. This means that the checks establish consistency within the dependencies the platform records, and an engineer must still judge the assumptions, the models and what the rules do not cover. The missed faults point to rules that compare values that today only change together, such as a datasheet duty against the flowsheet; a rule is a small piece of deterministic code, and benchmarks with planted faults on open plants would show how far the coverage has come.

paragraphs.en: An open ecosystem. Much engineering knowledge sits in proprietary project files, vendor-specific tools and internal databases. ChemE-as-Code keeps it in open, documented formats, so a project remains readable without any single application, tools and skills from different organizations can work on the same files, and commercial systems, whose scope and certification open tools do not replace, can read and write them through DEXPI and CAPE-OPEN [ 15 , 40 ] . Open projects matter most. Complete, machine-readable plants with their models, drawings, decisions, safety studies and inventories have rarely been openly available [ 55 , 56 ] . They could serve as benchmarks, teaching material and shared expertise [ 22 ] , and because their assumptions and open points are public, engineers can review them by raising issues and proposing changes. Life cycle inventories derived from such projects can be recalculated from their models, which established databases such as ecoinvent [ 88 ] do not expose. The Process Atlas, an open database of process models and LCIs generated from the process library, is a forthcoming application [ 89 ] ; its breadth and data quality are not results of this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 一个开放的生态系统。 许多工程知识存在于专有的项目文件、特定厂商的工具和内部数据库中。 ChemE-as-Code 将其保存在开放、有文档说明的格式中，因此项目无需任何单一应用程序即可保持可读性，来自不同组织的工具和技能可以处理相同的文件，而那些范围和认证并非开放工具所能替代的商业系统，也可以通过 DEXPI 和 CAPE-OPEN 读取和写入这些文件 [ 15 , 40 ] 。 开放的项目最为重要。 包含模型、图纸、决策、安全研究和物料清单的完整、机器可读的工厂，很少以开放形式提供 [ 55 , 56 ] 。 它们可以作为基准、教学材料和共享的专业知识 [ 22 ] ，而且由于它们的假设和开放问题都是公开的，工程师可以通过提出议题和提交修改建议来进行评审。 从这类项目导出的生命周期清单可以根据其模型重新计算，而 ecoinvent [ 88 ] 等成熟数据库并不提供这一功能。 Process Atlas 是一个由过程库生成的过程模型和 LCI 的开放数据库，是一个即将推出的应用 [ 89 ] ；其广度和数据质量并非本文的研究成果。

paragraphs.en: Risks. Three risks follow directly from this work [ 22 ] . The first is over-trust. In the ammonia case, a capacity change produced zero errors although the plant had not been resized; an engineer who reads a clean check as a complete design is misled. The platform reports calculation maturity and open warnings next to the errors and records who reviewed what, but the habit of reading the evidence rather than the status has to be built. The second is liability and certification. When an agent drafts a design and an agent accepts it, no person has taken responsibility for it, and current codes assume that one has. Rules are needed on who approves an agent-made design, which record of the agent’s work an approval must cite, and which checks a certifying body accepts as evidence; the run records, review records and sign-off rules of this platform are a starting point, not a substitute. The third is the training of engineers. Junior engineers learn much of their craft through the routine checking and data transfer that agents now take over, and the profession could lose the judgment that review needs unless this experience is built in new ways, for example by having junior engineers review and challenge agent work together with its evidence. An error in a shared skill, rule or template could also spread to many designs at once, and machine-readable plant models raise questions of cyber security and intellectual property, which we note without treating them here.
paragraphs.zh: 风险。 这项工作直接引出三个风险 [ 22 ]。第一个是过度信任。 在氨厂案例中，尽管装置并未重新确定尺寸，一次产能变更却产生零错误；把干净的检查结果当作完整设计来读的工程师会被误导。 本平台在错误旁边报告计算成熟度和未决警告，并记录谁审查了什么内容，但阅读证据而非状态的这一习惯仍须培养。 第二个是责任与认证。 当一个智能体起草设计、另一个智能体接受它时，没有任何人为此承担责任，而现行规范假设有人承担了责任。 需要就以下问题制定规则：谁批准智能体制作的设计、批准必须引用智能体工作的哪些记录、以及认证机构接受哪些检查作为证据；本平台的运行记录、审查记录和签署规则只是一个起点，而非替代品。 第三个是工程师的培养。 初级工程师在常规检查和数据传递中习得大量技能，而智能体如今接管了这些工作；除非以新的方式构建这种经验，例如让初级工程师结合证据共同审查和质疑智能体的工作，否则本行业可能丧失审查所需的判断力。 共享技能、规则或模板中的错误也可能同时扩散到许多设计中，机器可读的装置模型则引发网络安全和知识产权的问题，我们在对此予以指出，但不在此处处理。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The case study is illustrative and agent-generated, with the author’s recorded interventions. Its reviewers are agents of the same model as its designers, so their findings show what the model catches in its own work, not what an engineer would catch. The checks establish consistency within the rules that exist; engineering judgment and plausibility, mechanical design, relief sizing, dynamics, the correctness of a HAZOP rating and dependencies not yet fingerprinted, such as datasheet duties, lie outside them, which is why the held-out faults and the capacity change found what they did. The case uses one general-purpose agent in workflow roles and offers no controlled comparison with other agent architectures or with the same agent without skills, the comparison that would show what the skills contribute. Proprietary tools hold most industrial data, DEXPI coverage is incomplete, and agents are nondeterministic, so two runs of the same brief give different designs. ChemE-as-Code is a first open research prototype, and these limits should be read in that context. The same pattern could extend to the operation of existing plants, to laboratory work where experiments and synthesis procedures are already written as code [ 90 , 91 ] , and to molecular and product design; the core is layered by domain so that such domains can be added.

paragraphs.en: AI agents offer the prospect of substantially accelerating chemical process engineering and reducing its cost, but realizing this requires more than capable models. We argue that engineering knowledge must be connected, machine-readable and checkable, so that agents can work across disciplines while engineers keep responsibility for decisions and approval.
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体有望大幅加速化学过程工程并降低其成本，但要实现这一点，仅靠能力强大的模型是不够的。 我们认为，工程知识必须以互联互通、机器可读且可校验的形式存在，这样智能体才能跨学科开展工作，同时工程师保留对决策和审批的责任。

sents.en: We argue that engineering knowledge must be connected, machine-readable and checkable, so that agents can work across disciplines while engineers keep responsibility for decisions and approval.
sents.zh: 我们认为，工程知识必须以互联互通、机器可读且可校验的形式存在，这样智能体才能跨学科开展工作，同时工程师保留对决策和审批的责任。

paragraphs.en: ChemE-as-Code implements this through two foundations: a versioned repository of linked engineering files, and an open library of deterministic tools and agent skills that spans chemical engineering from catalysis and reaction kinetics to plant layout and LCA. A general-purpose agent uses these across disciplines, while calculations, checks and approval stay outside the LLM, with approval reserved for people in the proposed workflow. In an illustrative natural-gas ammonia case, agent sessions turned a written brief into a preliminary package that passed the platform’s basic-stage gates, with HAZOP, datasheets and relief cases, for USD 224 of API cost in the design sessions, and a comparison with open references indicates that the design is plausible. The checks caught every fault written with knowledge of the rules but only some of the faults written without them, and a capacity change raised no errors although the plant had not been resized. An error-free result therefore shows consistency, not a complete or correct design. The case shows that the workflow runs. It does not establish the quality of the design or a productivity gain, and no independent engineer has reviewed the result.
paragraphs.zh: ChemE-as-Code 通过两个基础来实现这一点：一个带版本的关联工程文件存储库，以及一个涵盖从催化与反应动力学到装置布置和生命周期评估（LCA）的确定性工具与智能体技能的开放库。 通用智能体跨学科使用这些资源，而计算、校核和审批留在 LLM 之外，且在所提出的工作流程中审批保留给人员。 在一个天然气制氨的示例案例中，智能体会话将一份书面任务书转化为通过了平台基础阶段门禁的初步文件包，其中包含 HAZOP、数据表和泄放工况，设计会话的 API 成本为 224 美元，与公开文献的比较表明该设计是合理的。 这些校核捕获了所有在知晓规则的情况下写入的故障，但只捕获了部分在不知晓规则的情况下写入的故障；此外，尽管装置规模并未重新核算，一次产能变更却没有引发任何错误。 因此，无错误的结果只表明一致性，而非完整或正确的设计。 该案例表明该工作流程可以运行。 它并未确立设计的质量或生产率的提升，也没有独立工程师对结果进行过审查。

paragraphs.en: Beyond automation, ChemE-as-Code lays a foundation for an open chemical engineering ecosystem in which process models, engineering data, decisions and the evidence behind them are reusable assets rather than remaining inside single tools and projects. The longer-term opportunity is to change how engineering knowledge is created, checked, shared and reused, first in process and plant design and then across chemical engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 超越自动化之外，ChemE-as-Code 为一个开放的化学工程生态系统奠定了基础，在这一生态系统中，过程模型、工程数据、决策及其背后的依据都是可复用的资产，而不是只留存在单一工具和项目之中。 更长期的机会在于改变工程知识被创建、校验、共享和复用的方式，首先应用于过程与工厂设计，然后推广到整个化学工程领域。

paragraphs.en: ChemE-as-Code is developed openly in the ChemE-as-Code organization on GitHub ( https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code ); all repositories listed below are public. The core library, which validates, formats, renders and compares DEXPI P&IDs and engineering YAML files kept in Git and includes the web viewer for plant repositories, is available at https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/core (GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later). It builds on pyDEXPI, available at https://github.com/process-intelligence-research/pyDEXPI . A template for starting new plant repositories is available at https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/project-template ; the template carries no license, so that the content of each plant repository remains its owner’s to license. The process library, including the ammonia case study ( processes/ammonia-1 ) and its run records at tag nh3-run-final , is available at https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/process-library (code under GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later, except the LCI database installer, which is under the MIT license; process data and designs under CC BY 4.0 unless a process states otherwise). The project website is https://cheme-as-code.org , and the Process Atlas generated from the process library is available at https://atlas.cheme-as-code.org . The scripts and raw results of the evaluation in Section 5.5 are archived on Zenodo [ 92 ] .

sents.zh: 它构建于 pyDEXPI 之上，pyDEXPI 的地址为 https://github.com/process-intelligence-research/pyDEXPI 。

sents.en: A template for starting new plant repositories is available at https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/project-template ; the template carries no license, so that the content of each plant repository remains its owner’s to license.
sents.zh: 用于创建新工厂仓库的模板位于 https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/project-template ；该模板不附带许可证，因此每个工厂仓库的内容仍由其所有者自行选择许可证。

sents.en: The process library, including the ammonia case study ( processes/ammonia-1 ) and its run records at tag nh3-run-final , is available at https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/process-library (code under GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later, except the LCI database installer, which is under the MIT license; process data and designs under CC BY 4.0 unless a process states otherwise).
sents.zh: 过程库（包括氨案例研究（processes/ammonia-1）及其在标签 nh3-run-final 处的运行记录）位于 https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/process-library （代码采用 GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later 许可证，但 LCI 数据库安装程序除外，其采用 MIT 许可证；除非某过程另有说明，过程数据与设计采用 CC BY 4.0 许可证）。

sents.en: The project website is https://cheme-as-code.org , and the Process Atlas generated from the process library is available at https://atlas.cheme-as-code.org .
sents.zh: 项目网站为 https://cheme-as-code.org ，由过程库生成的 Process Atlas 位于 https://atlas.cheme-as-code.org 。
